notes.title: PRINCESS NOW AVAILABLE
notes.notes:
[h1][b]I AM PLEASED TO ANNOUNCE "PRINCESS"[/b][/h1]
[h2][b]I invite fans of retro RPG games to check it out![/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695040/b4af28e8b6b76b1933118ec40759bfd024a93d41.png[/img]

Traverse a vast non-linear kingdom of endless secrets, hostile creatures, and unfair death traps as you discover bountiful weapons, gear and items.

Level up as you fight off common adversaries in button-mashing action, and take down malevolent guardians in calculated turn-based battles.
